why: Stone's weight gives way to the root's slow force
Planting long ago shows now as shade
Ripening at own pace, pressing cannot hurry it
What stands between two sides belongs to both
Takes a side openly, alone bears the cost
Move stopped just before it is made
Daily work long before ripens into result
A way handed down is carried on
Shared joy in the middle of a chore
Shoot splits tarmac: resistance gives way to force
Mother stands guard between hand and kittens
Bends double under strain and does not break
Old home's key still carried, choice to keep
Laughter grows together amid the spoiled picnic
Fragile beginning given room, not corrected by force
Stop at threshold protects from what rush missed
Old beams kept and chosen to carry the new
Return to same place, building on what was left
Shared pleasure without being finished
Fragile life given room then grows
Spoken word at right moment changes the room
Standing in the gap between two states
One turn and same map reads differently
Outside force breaks the whole plan at once
Two find common rhythm, then progress
Understands own lesson through another person
Closed, contents exist but not yet known
Shift in seeing that cannot go back
Uninvited force, afterwards shows what is gone
Neither forces, two walk at one pace
A heard word arrives and gains meaning
Images exist unseen, undeveloped, unknown
Midpoint turn from dark toward light
Storm shows what is gone and what held
Blade runs only when neither pushes
A path made only by walking it
Kept closed while it completes inside
Empty page, nothing yet written
Scarcity shows the one thing truly needed
Hears oneself mirrored in a friend
Easy rhythm of road no longer leads where meant
Open enough to see, not letting all in
Unnamed space left unwritten
Constraint of one match forces what is needed
Seeking oneself among the others
Rhythm found only by keeping moving
Watcher stands between swimmers and the danger
Sign without any marking, direction unwritten
Lack makes the need felt each time
Self shown back through another, recognised by all
Small light reveals what lay there all along
Puts herself between threat and nest
Surplus passes on and feeds growth
Moving water stopped and held as it is
Sensed and acted on before it can be explained
Light shows what was long there, cannot be unseen
Sun clears fog, you see where you stand
Left unused, it lost its strength
Rising movement stopped and held under ice
Movement under surface sensed before seen
A spark that fades unless fed at once
Sun simply shines and its strength melts frost
Used stays alive, left standing seizes
Motion halted mid-fall, one drop held in view
Hidden current finding its own way inside
Something passes between two hands and returns enriched
Light too bright dazzles until eyes adjust
Bodily force appears when needed, weight yields
Movement stopped, in stillness one thing in view
Outwardly still, transformation completing inside
Giving both ways, nothing counted
Keeps to truth and knowingly pays for it
Resistance yields to whole-body force
Opening what ripens inside before ready ruins it
Complete within, closed and ready, nothing visible happening
Help given returns; what arises belongs to both
Choosing one side and forgoing the other
